summary.text: Andrea Harrison is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 24, where she has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Harrison's 2025-2026 committee assignments, according to Ballotpedia, include the Economic Matters Committee, the Audit and Evaluation Committee, the Fair Practices and State Personnel Oversight Committee, and the Workers' Compensation Benefit and Insurance Oversight Committee, where she is House chair.
